title: Combining GHOST and Casper (Gasper)
venue: Vitalik Buterin, Diego Hernandez, Thor Kamphefner, Khiem Pham, Zhi Qiao, Danny Ryan, Juhyeok Sin, Ying Wang, Yan X Zhang — arXiv:2003.03052
quote: We present "Gasper," a proof-of-stake-based consensus protocol, which is an idealized version of the proposed Ethereum 2.0 beacon chain. The protocol combines Casper FFG, a finality tool, with LMD GHOST, a fork-choice rule. We prove safety, plausible liveness, and probabilistic liveness under different sets of assumptions.

title: Casper the Friendly Finality Gadget
quote: We introduce Casper, a proof of stake-based finality system which overlays an existing proof of work blockchain. Casper is a partial consensus mechanism combining proof of stake algorithm research and Byzantine fault tolerant consensus theory. We introduce our system, prove some desirable features, and show defenses against long range revisions and catastrophic crashes.

title: EIP-7251: Increase the MAX_EFFECTIVE_BALANCE

quote: Increases the constant `MAX_EFFECTIVE_BALANCE`, while keeping the minimum staking balance `32 ETH`. … As of October 3, 2023, there are currently over 830,000 validators participating in the consensus layer. … large validators can consolidate to run fewer validators and thus fewer beacon nodes … small validators [benefit] from compounding rewards and the ability to stake in more flexible increments.

title: Staking — ethereum.org
quote: Home staking is the 'most impactful' option; centralized exchanges are the 'least impactful'. … Your ETH is at stake, with penalties for going offline and potential slashing (larger penalties and ejection) for misconduct. … Staking as a service carries the same risks as solo staking plus counter-party risk of service provider, since use of your signing keys is entrusted to someone else. … For pooled staking, some projects require as little as 0.01 ETH. … Centralized exchanges create a large centralized target and point of failure, making the network more vulnerable to attack or bugs.

title: Ethereum Staking Statistics & Trends (2026 Data)
quote: 39 million ETH are currently staked across all validators, representing roughly 32% of the 121,709,365 ETH total supply. Lido accounts for 8,863,785 ETH, which represents 22.7% of total staked ETH.

title: Lido Initiates Overhaul By Shifting Billions In Staked Ether To Higher-Capacity Validators
quote: The Lido DAO approved Curated Module v2 (CMv2) in late July 2026. Lido is migrating stake from its extensive fleet of legacy 0x01 validators—numbering over 265,000 in the curated set—into higher-capacity units. Once complete, the proportion of network stake secured by these compounding validators is projected to rise from roughly 32% to about 52%, with Ethereum's overall validator count expected to fall by approximately one-third, from around 880,000 to near 628,000.
